purpose: V6-A core engine plus regime-sized V6-B dynamic theme sleeve with portfolio-level dynamic GLD/BIL overlay.

v6b_dynamic_sizing.high_weight_rule: Use 45% V6-B when V6-B 126-trading-day return is >= 8% and SPY plus QQQ are both above 200-day moving averages.
v6b_dynamic_sizing.low_weight_rule: Use 5% V6-B when V6-B 63-trading-day return is <= -8%, or when market is below trend and A/B 63-day correlation is >= 60%.
v6b_dynamic_sizing.remaining_weight_rule: Allocate the remaining non-overlay weight to V6-A.

v6b_profile.description: ETF theme discovery -> theme-to-stock expression; top3 themes; guarded risk controls; 90% risk weight inside V6-B sleeve.

dynamic_overlay.hedge_selection_rule: Use GLD when GLD is above its 126-day moving average; otherwise use BIL.
dynamic_overlay.overlay_policy: Overlay is not permanent. It reallocates part of V6-A/V6-B risk budget when market, volatility, drawdown, or correlation triggers fire.

known_weaknesses: This is still research and paper-sim only.
Dynamic B sizing must be monitored for regime misclassification.
Do not promote to live capital before paper sim confirms intended daily weights and execution feasibility.

required_monitoring: dynamic overlay weight and hedge asset
current drawdown versus candidate max drawdown
stop_or_review_conditions: computed V6-B target weight differs from executed paper weight by more than 5 percentage points
A/B rolling 63-day correlation >= 0.75 while SPY or QQQ is below 200-day moving average
V6-B sleeve loses more than 8% from local peak while target weight remains above 30%
any execution mismatch between intended sleeve weights and paper orders
